messages:
alex: Customer ACME reports /v1/call failing 400. Error: "Invalid JSON: Unexpected token } in JSON at position 85"

alex: Payload they sent (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/call' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-raw '{"tool":"pdf_extract","args":"{\"path\":\"C:\\Users\\Bob\\Documents\\report.pdf\",}"}'
```

priya: Can you paste the request-id / server log? this looks like a trailing-comma inside a stringified args + windows backslashes not escaped :thinking:

alex: Server log: parse error while decoding tool args: invalid character '}' after object key

support-bot: Created ticket INC-2026 for ACME — assigned to eng oncall

eli: Likely PowerShell/Win32 paste + double-stringify. Repro on Windows PS:
```powershell
$payload = '{"tool":"pdf_extract","args":"{\"path\":\"C:\\Users\\Bob\\Documents\\report.pdf\",}"}'
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/call' -Method Post -Body $payload -ContentType 'application/json'
```

eli: Fix on client: send args as a JSON object not a string. Correct payload:
```json
{"tool":"pdf_extract","args":{"path":"C:\\Users\\Bob\\Documents\\report.pdf"}}
```

eli: Short-term server mitigation proposal: gateway tries to detect stringified args, attempt JSON.parse; if that fails, run a small sanitizer: strip CR (\r), remove trailing commas in objects/arrays via a safe regex, then try parse. If sanitized parse succeeds log as 'toolargs-sanitized' and return 202; if not, return 422 with clear hint and KB link.

priya: Customer cannot patch today, would appreciate temporary gateway accept. Is sanitization risky? :shrug:

eli: It's a small pragmatic change; I'll open a short-lived feature flag and roll to staging. If we see >0.1% new errors we'll roll back. Filing ENG-4298.

alex: Thanks — please add the sanitization logs and update ACME with INC-2026/ENG-4298. Customer said they can wait for a same-day workaround. :thumbsup:
